title: Climate Gazette
text:
Climate Gazette features stories of extreme weather events that occurred in Europe over the past 40 years. Reports are based on data from the European Climate Index, analysed with Jupyter and presented via charts and maps.



 





Issue 1 - November 2026


Developed during the [title] workshop held at the Visualising Climate Conference 2026, Bologna.  Curated by Noemi Ambrosi, Simona Contaldi, Cinzia Bongino.
